title: Wicked themed UEFN Island
description: (Ongoing) A UEFN Island inspired by Wicked the musical, mainly a prototype to experiment with UEFN tools and workflows, including environment design using Landscape Mode, Verse scripting for custom interactions, and basic Devices familiarity (experimented with Physics puzzle solving). Next step is adding character animation for NPC dance (like the musical) and more!

details.focus: VR design, naive guest experience, playtesting, rapid development

title: Prison Escape
description: Roomscale VR Escape room designed for naive guests. Fleshed out the player experience and puzzles after concept inception. Worked as Unity programmer in a 5-person team, rapidly creating the experience in 2 weeks, from concept inception to playtesting and iteration.

details.focus: VR design, naive guest experience, playtesting, rapid development

title: Little Match Girl MR Experience
description: Visual storytelling experience where players traverse between real and virtual worlds. Defined soundscapes for transitioning between physical/passthrough mode and VR virtual space, and integrated adaptive audio using FMOD.

title: Breathe Deep
description: Global Game Jam Pittsburgh submission that won Jammer's Award. 2-player game where players posed as pirates dodging sea creatures and competing for bubbles for air underwater. Worked as programmer and technical sound designer, implementing bubble mechanics and FMOD integration.
role: Game Designer, Gameplay Programmer, Technical Sound Designer

title: Husky Hangout
description: Mobile app designed to help international students at University of Washington find community through shared interests. In charge of user research and interview + survey design, as well as user testing for the Figma interactive prototype on usertesting.com.

title: MiniJava Compiler
description: Developed basic compiler for MiniJava (Java subset). Implemented scanning + parsing using jFlex CUP tools after defining programming language grammar according to specs. Created abstract syntax tree AST traversal using visitor pattern for type checking and code generation in Assembly language.

title: MUPL Interpreter
description: Built Made-Up-Programming_Language(MUPL) interpreter in Racket, implementing functional programming language concepts such as first-class functions, lexical scoping, and macros.

title: Pacman AI Agent
description: Implemented pathfinding algorithms including BFS, DFS, and A*, as well as adversarial agent decision-making and pruning optimizationfor Pacman environment. Also experimented with Q-learning for reinforcement learning agent.

title: Spelunx Toolkit - Multiplayer Roomscale VR UGC Ecosystem
description: A Unity SDK aimed for novice to seasoned developers for the multiplayer roomscale VR platform CAVERN. The toolkit includes the Unity package, tutorial, sample scenes, and technical documentation.

details.focus: Developer experience research, playtesting, surround sound design, sample scene development

title: In The End - R&D for VR Haptics in Emotional Storytelling
description: An R&D project exploring proactive haptic cues in VR for emotional engagement, culminating to the award-winning experience about death called In The End.

details.focus: Innovative haptic R&D, playtesting, prototype development,cross-disciplinary collaboration
details.tools: Unity 6, Meta SDK, bHaptics TactGlove, Trello

title: Two to Foxtrot
description: Designed 2-player co-op platformer where players see different aspects of the world. Designed the interactive puzzles including 2 phases of resource collection, as well as a final boss encounter for escape the forest. Served as main programmer implementing player systems and puzzle mechanics.

title: EiAi - UX Research on LLMs usage in UX Designers
description: Explored how UX designers utilize LLM tools to understand hard-to-reach user populations through mixed methods research including contextual inquiry, usability testing, assumption artifacts, and speed dating.

title: Population One - Cooperative Puzzle-Narrative Game across 4 Mobile Screens
description: A semester-long investigation in discovering unique narrative puzzle game systems across 4 phone screens, where physical repositioning of the devices serve as the main mechanic.

details.focus: System Design, Documentation, Cross-disciplinary Collaboration, (System Design, Player Advocate)

title: Voice in the Void
description: Game jam submission for That Game Company X Coreblazer Jam. A relaxation building game where players connect with AI aliens' encrypted messages with a generous heart. Implemented resource collection and building mechanics.

title: The Glad Game - Educational Game Design for Metacognition
description: Independent study with game designer Jesse Schell. After iterations, I designed a branching narrative game that facilitates players to learn about cognitive biases in real life, and implemented the tutorial and 1st level prototype with Unity and ink.

details.focus: Developer experience research, playtesting, surround sound design, sample scene development
